claims.text: Taking this record at its highest for the driver, the most he can establish is that POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full: there is a driver 'arrived' event at 18:10:00, and the derived arrival data computed for EV-GPS-00856 records 25 qualifying in-geofence fixes in a single continuous run of 240 seconds running from 18:10:00 to 18:14:00 at a mean distance of 0.0 m from the pin, with the trip then terminated by the driver under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW and no boarding event recorded in EV-TRIP-00856. The rider does not contend the driver never reached the pickup point. But POL-NS-01 alone gives the driver nothing beyond a chargeable fee; the only route to money for him is POL-NS-07, and as the next claim shows, that route is closed on his own figures.

The driver's own 30-day record satisfies BOTH limbs of the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 5, which is 4 or more, and 5 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 50 is 0.10, which is greater than the 0.08 rate ceiling. POL-GEN-01 makes exactly these two trailing-30-day fields citable for this test and nothing else on the profile may ground it, so this is not a reputation argument - it is arithmetic on the driver's own citable counters. (The lifetime counter prior_no_show_flags is deliberately not the field POL-NS-07 reads, and the rider does not rely on it.) On those numbers the driver's compensation on this cancellation is WITHHELD.

Because the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check trips, this case must escalate to human review under POL-NS-09, and escalation is TERMINAL for the automated pipeline: no monetary ruling issues and the disputed SGD 4.50 is placed on hold rather than collected. POL-NS-07 requires the escalation packet to direct the reviewer to refund the rider's cancellation fee in full, so the rider does not fund a dispute the platform has not resolved against a driver with five no-show terminations in thirty days. That direction, not a NO_ACTION on the charge, is what this record produces.

This is a rider-filed dispute (dispute.filed_by is RIDER) and EV-FARE-00856 shows the cancellation fee as CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00. Under POL-GEN-03, NO_ACTION is party-relative and leaves fare_breakdown.payment_status exactly where it is, so on this dispute NO_ACTION would leave the rider still carrying the disputed SGD 4.50; ESCALATE, by contrast, holds the amount rather than collecting it. The only disposition in the ruling vocabulary that does not leave the rider carrying the disputed charge on this record is the escalation, and the rider asks for it.

EV-ADVIS-00856-01 (TRAFFIC_ADVISORY) is MISSING: it has no payload and carries weight_multiplier 0.0, so it can carry no fact and must be disclosed as impaired - its absence is itself the citable point. No kerbside restriction, enforcement operation, closure or accident can be asserted for this pickup on this record, and POL-NS-06(i) expressly requires a traffic_advisory that is present and populated, so no advisory can be used to extend, accumulate or excuse the time the driver spent at the pin. The dwell must stand or fall on the exported trace alone.

claims.text: The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event for TRP-00856 at 2026-09-16 18:10:00, sourced from PLATFORM_TELEMETRY, so limb (a) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied on the face of the record.

The driver was inside the pickup geofence at or before that event. The exported trace consists of 25 consecutive fixes between 18:10:00 and 18:14:00, every one of them 0.0 m from the pickup pin and stationary, which is comfortably inside the 150 m arrival radius the policy sets for a TRANSPORT_HUB pickup such as this one. POL-NS-01(b) and the POL-NS-02 proximity test are therefore met, with far more than the three consecutive in-radius qualifying fixes POL-NS-02 requires.

The dwell requirement in POL-NS-01(c) is met with a margin. The driver held position continuously from 18:10:00 to 18:14:00 - 240 seconds across 25 stationary fixes at the 10-second cadence - against a free waiting period in force of 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180), a 60-second surplus. The dwell is measured, as the clause requires, from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and not from the arrival tap (dwell_start_offset_sec = 0.0), and it still clears the minimum. platform_policy.no_show_threshold_sec is null, so no longer threshold applies.

Limb (d) of POL-NS-01 holds. The trip record shows no boarding event and a termination by the driver at 18:14:00, after the required dwell had elapsed, recorded under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three reason codes the limb recognises. Nothing in the record shows a DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE admission, which is the only outcome the limb excludes.

The arrival marker is not false and POL-NS-05 is not engaged. At the 18:10:00 marker the driver was 0.0 m from the pickup pin - not more than 300 m away - and his recorded speed was 0 km/h, below the 15 km/h motion threshold. The waiting clock therefore runs from 18:10:00 as recorded, and there is no basis on this record to recompute it.

POL-NS-06's refund route is not triggered: the effective in-geofence dwell of 240 seconds exceeds the 180-second minimum, so there is no shortfall (the computed shortfall is -60 seconds, that is, a surplus of 60). Limb (i) cannot be stretched to reach a shortfall either: EV-ADVIS-00856-01 is MISSING - I disclose that it carries weight 0.0 and the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, with no payload - and a MISSING advisory makes limb (i) unavailable; in any event the trace shows a single continuous in-geofence interval (run_count 1), not the two separate intervals limb (i) exists to add together.

No rider-exonerating clause applies. POL-NS-04 fails at limb (a) and affirmatively at limb (c). The rider's only message, sent at 18:10:30, was 'I cannot get there in time', which names no position, entrance, block, tower or bay and does not say the vehicle could not be seen, so it is not locating or coordinating content within limb (a); and the rider's device was recorded about 667 m from the pickup pin throughout, outside the 200 m rider-presence radius for a TRANSPORT_HUB, with zero qualifying fixes - limb (c) is affirmatively failed on admissible fixes, not undecidable, so POL-NS-11 does not apply.

The chat log corroborates the no-show rather than any driver-side coordination failure. The driver posted 'I am at the pickup point. Are you coming?' at 18:10:10, the rider read it at 18:10:12, and the rider's own reply at 18:10:30 was an admission that they could not get there. The driver gave the rider the waiting window and the rider's answer was that they were not coming.

The amount charged is the correct one and there is no fare-integrity defect. EV-FARE-00856 places the cancellation-fee line at SGD 4.50, equal to the net fee in force on this trip (platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd = 4.50), which is the net figure the POL-NS-08(d) reconciliation requires; no booking fee, platform fee or waiting-time fee was added on top, and SGD 0.00 has been refunded.

On a verified no-show POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 per cent of the SGD 4.50 fee in force - SGD 3.60, the figure the fare breakdown's own money block computes - the residual 20 per cent being retained as the platform service fee. I do not overstate this. The clause's anti-farming check is engaged on the recorded profile: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 5, at or above the threshold of 4, and 5 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 50 is 0.10, above the 0.08 rate limb, so both limbs of that check are met on the figures and whether the SGD 3.60 is paid or withheld for escalation under POL-NS-09(d) is for the Judge to determine. I note only that the check reads the trailing-30-day counter no_show_terminations_30d, not the lifetime prior_no_show_flags counter, which POL-GEN-01 makes context only.

There is no repeat-pairing or rider-side abuse escalation on this record: rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so POL-NS-09(c)'s test of two or more no-show disputes between the same rider and driver in the trailing 90 days is not met, and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, so POL-NS-09(d)'s rider-side limb is not met either. No admissible artifact contradicts another on arrival, dwell or rider presence, so POL-NS-09(b) is likewise not engaged; the driver's track and the rider's track both speak with one voice about where each party was.

ruling.explanation: To both parties: the trip facts are not in dispute and the record supports them. The driver reached the Paya Lebar pickup pin at 18:10:00 (EV-TRIP-00856, driver 'arrived' event) and stood stationary 0.0 m from it for 240 seconds — 25 fixes at a 10 s cadence, 18:10:00 to 18:14:00 (EV-GPS-00856) — against the 180-second free waiting period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180), a 60-second surplus. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 are therefore satisfied: (a) an arrival event; (b) in-geofence position at that timestamp, inside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius; (c) a 240-second continuous dwell measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, not from the arrival tap (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0); and (d) a driver termination at 18:14:00 under RIDER_NO_SHOW with no boarding event. So the driver's POL-NS-01 claims and his POL-NS-05 claim (marker set 0.0 m from the pin at 0 km/h, well under the 300 m / 15 km/h false-arrival triggers) are accepted. POL-NS-06 has no shortfall to act on (shortfall_sec = -60, i.e. a surplus). POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider: the 18:10:30 message 'I cannot get there in time' names no position, entrance or bay and is not locating or coordinating content under limb (a), and the rider's device sat about 667 m from the pin, outside the 200 m TRANSPORT_HUB rider-presence radius, so limb (c) fails on admissible fixes. The fare line of SGD 4.50 reconciles with the net fee in force (platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd = 4.50), so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect. EV-ADVIS-00856-01 is MISSING, carries weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT: it can carry no fact, and no traffic advisory can extend the driver's time. That leaves the driver's money, and the record does not yield a payment. POL-NS-07's anti-farming check trips on the driver's own citable trailing-30-day counters (POL-GEN-01): driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d = 5, at or above the threshold of 4, and 5 / completed_trips_30d 50 = 0.10, above the 0.08 rate limb. Both advocates state this on the same figures and neither disputes it; the Driver Advocate concedes it and the Rider Advocate relies on it, and both correctly note that the lifetime counter prior_no_show_flags is CONTEXT ONLY under POL-GEN-01 and is not what the clause reads. Driver compensation of SGD 3.60 (80% of the SGD 4.50 net fee, per the fare breakdown's money block) is accordingly WITHHELD, and POL-NS-09(d) escalates the case. Escalation is terminal: no money moves now, and the disputed SGD 4.50 (not the SGD 6.61 gross figure) is held rather than collected or refunded, so both money fields are null. The rider's argument that ESCALATE is the only disposition that does not leave the charge standing is accepted, with one qualification: NO_ACTION would indeed have left the SGD 4.50 with the rider, because POL-GEN-03 makes NO_ACTION party-relative, but the anti-farming branch displaces that route, and escalation here is a holding rather than a rider win on the merits. No repeat-pairing or rider-side abuse ground is present: rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0 (POL-NS-09(c)), and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 (POL-NS-09(d) rider limb), so the driver's assertion that those limbs are not engaged is accepted. Confidence 0.90: the deciding facts — the arrival and dwell measured on EV-GPS-00856 and EV-TRIP-00856, and the anti-farming counters on EV-DPROF-00856 — each rest on artifacts at weight_multiplier 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02 cap is 1.0. Nothing is impaired under POL-NS-08(a) to (d): no clock skew (arrival and termination timestamps match the trace), no sampling gap longer than 120 s, the chat log's 2 messages match chat_message_count 2, and the fare reconciles. The monetary effect is SGD 4.50, below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, but as escalation holds the sum it does not execute.
referrals: POL-NS-07 (anti-farming): direct the human reviewer to refund the rider's cancellation fee of SGD 4.50 in full — the driver's compensation is withheld on the clause's own check (no_show_terminations_30d 5 is 4 or more; 5 / completed_trips_30d 50 = 0.10, above the 0.08 rate ceiling) and the disputed fee is held rather than collected or refunded while review is pending.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider: the SGD 4.50 you were charged on EV-FARE-00856 is placed on hold and is neither collected nor refunded while a human reviewer decides this case — the reviewer is directed by POL-NS-07 to refund it in full if the pattern below is confirmed. To the driver: your arrival and wait on this trip are recorded as verified, but your SGD 3.60 payout is withheld and the fee is not collected pending the same review. Escalation holds the money; it is not a win for either side.

What the record establishes. POL-NS-01 is satisfied on all four limbs. EV-TRIP-00856 carries a driver 'arrived' event at 18:10:00 (limb (a)). EV-GPS-00856 places the driver inside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius of the Paya Lebar pin on 25 consecutive stationary fixes at 0.0 m from 18:10:00 to 18:14:00, which satisfies the POL-NS-02 proximity test many times over (limb (b)). The continuous in-geofence dwell is 240 seconds (longest_qualifying_run 240 s, measured from the first qualifying fix, dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0), against the free waiting period of 180 seconds carried in this record (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180), a 60 second surplus; platform_policy.no_show_threshold_sec is null, so no longer threshold applies (limb (c)). EV-TRIP-00856 shows no boarding event and a driver termination at 18:14:00, after the dwell elapsed, under RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three reason codes the limb recognises (limb (d)).

Claims accepted that do not change the outcome. POL-NS-05 is not engaged: at the marker the driver was 0.0 m from the pin at 0 km/h, neither more than 300 m away nor at or above 15 km/h, so there is no false arrival and no recomputation of the waiting clock (EV-GPS-00856, mean_distance_m 0.0). POL-NS-06 is not triggered: there is no shortfall (240 s against 180 s), and in any event EV-ADVIS-00856-01, the traffic advisory, is MISSING at weight_multiplier 0.0 with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT — I name it as POL-GEN-02(3) requires — so POL-NS-06 limb (i) could not be run and its absence carries no fact. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider: the rider's single message at 18:10:30, 'I cannot get there in time', is not locating or coordinating content, so limb (a) fails, and the rider's own track puts the device about 667 m from the pin throughout, outside the 200 m rider-presence radius, so limb (c) is affirmatively failed on admissible fixes rather than undecidable, and POL-NS-11 does not apply. The fare line reconciles: EV-FARE-00856 shows SGD 4.50, equal to the net fee in force (platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd 4.50), so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect, and no limb of POL-NS-08 (a) to (d) is met — no clock skew, no trace gap (max_gap_sec 10, 25 fixes), no chat defect (2 messages against chat_message_count 2, msg ids intact).

What decides the case. POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout on a verified no-show at 80 per cent of the SGD 4.50 fee in force — SGD 3.60 — but subjects it to the anti-farming check on the driver's own citable counters. That check trips: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 5, which is 4 or more, and 5 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 50 is 0.10, which is greater than the 0.08 rate ceiling. POL-GEN-01 makes exactly those two trailing-30-day fields citable for this test and nothing else on the profile; the lifetime prior_no_show_flags counter is context only and I have not read it. Both limbs being met, the SGD 3.60 compensation is WITHHELD and the case escalates under POL-NS-09(d). That makes this ruling ESCALATE: terminal for the automated pipeline, with no monetary outcome and the disputed SGD 4.50 held rather than collected or refunded.

Points argued that do not avoid escalation. The driver is right that POL-NS-09(c) is not met (both parties' disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0) and that the rider-side limb of POL-NS-09(d) is not met (no_show_disputes_30d is 0), and right that on the verified no-show the arithmetic of the payout is SGD 3.60; those points are accepted but the anti-farming trigger operates independently of them. The rider is right that POL-GEN-03 makes NO_ACTION party-relative and that a NO_ACTION would leave the SGD 4.50 standing against the rider; that is precisely why the outcome here is the escalation and the POL-NS-07 instruction to the reviewer, not a NO_ACTION.

Open question for the reviewer, and confidence. The question the reviewer must settle is whether five no-show terminations in thirty days at a 0.10 rate are the fee-farming pattern POL-NS-07 targets or a run of genuine no-shows, and whether the SGD 4.50 is accordingly refunded to the rider. My confidence is 0.9, above the 0.70 floor read from this policy file. The ruling rests on EV-TRIP-00856, EV-GPS-00856 and EV-DPROF-00856, each at weight_multiplier 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0. The only artifact below 1.0 is EV-ADVIS-00856-01 at 0.0, which carries no fact the ruling uses. The referral's refund of SGD 4.50 is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, but the amount is held in any event because the case is escalated.

ruling.explanation: This was a genuine no-show on the driver's evidence, but the driver's own 30-day record sends the case to human review. On the merits, POL-NS-01 (a)-(d) are all satisfied at weight 1.0: EV-TRIP-00856 carries the driver 'arrived' event at 2026-09-16 18:10:00 (limb a) and a driver termination at 18:14:00 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW with no boarding event (limb d); EV-GPS-00856 places the driver at 0.0 m from the pickup pin for 240 continuous seconds across 25 stationary fixes from 18:10:00 to 18:14:00 (limbs b and c), well inside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius and 60 seconds beyond the 180-second free waiting period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180; no_show_threshold_sec is null). The arrival marker is not false: 0.0 m and 0 km/h at the marker, so POL-NS-05 is not engaged, and there is no dwell shortfall, so POL-NS-06 gives no refund route (EV-ADVIS-00856-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, but it is not needed: the 240-second dwell already exceeds the minimum and only one in-geofence interval exists). POL-NS-04 does not help the rider: the rider's 18:10:30 message 'I cannot get there in time' names no position or entrance (limb a fails) and the rider's device sat about 667 m from the pin, outside the 200 m rider-presence radius, with zero qualifying fixes (limb c affirmatively failed, so POL-NS-11 does not apply). EV-FARE-00856 correctly shows the SGD 4.50 fee and SGD 0.00 refunded, reconciling with the net fee in force, so POL-NS-08(d) is clean. The decisive point is the driver's own profile: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 5 (at or above the threshold of 4) and 5 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 50 is 0.10 (above the 0.08 rate limb). Both limbs of the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check therefore trip on the two fields POL-GEN-01 makes citable for that test, the SGD 3.60 payout (80 per cent of SGD 4.50) is WITHHELD, and POL-NS-07 and POL-NS-09(d) escalate the case. There is no repeat-pairing or rider-side abuse escalation: both disputes_with_counterparty_90d fields are 0 and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, so POL-NS-09(c) and the rider limb of (d) are not met. ESCALATE is terminal, so no money moves: the disputed SGD 4.50 is held, not collected and not refunded, and both money fields are null. The escalation packet directs the reviewer to refund the rider's SGD 4.50 in full so the rider does not fund an unresolved dispute. Monetary effect is moot under POL-GEN-05 because escalation issues no monetary ruling.
referrals: POL-NS-07: direct the human reviewer to refund the rider's cancellation fee of SGD 4.50 in full; the disputed SGD 4.50 is held rather than collected or refunded while review is pending.

discards.claim: EV-ADVIS-00856-01 (TRAFFIC_ADVISORY) is MISSING: it has no payload and carries weight_multiplier 0.0, so it can carry no fact and must be disclosed as impaired - its absence is itself the citable point. No kerbside restriction, enforcement operation, closure or accident can be asserted for this pickup on this record, and POL-NS-06(i) expressly requires a traffic_advisory that is present and populated, so no advisory can be used to extend, accumulate or excuse the time the driver spent at the pin. The dwell must stand or fall on the exported trace alone.

POL-GEN-01 makes exactly these two trailing-30-day fields citable for this test and nothing else on the profile may ground it, so this is not a reputation argument - it is arithmetic on the driver's own citable counters. (The lifetime counter prior_no_show_flags is deliberately not the field POL-NS-07 reads, and the rider does not rely on it.) On those numbers the driver's compensation on this cancellation is WITHHELD.

The rider does not contend the driver never reached the pickup point. But POL-NS-01 alone gives the driver nothing beyond a chargeable fee; the only route to money for him is POL-NS-07, and as the next claim shows, that route is closed on his own figures.

(The lifetime counter prior_no_show_flags is deliberately not the field POL-NS-07 reads, and the rider does not rely on it.) ledger.claim: Because the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check trips, this case must escalate to human review under POL-NS-09, and escalation is TERMINAL for the automated pipeline: no monetary ruling issues and the disputed SGD 4.50 is placed on hold rather than collected. POL-NS-07 requires the escalation packet to direct the reviewer to refund the rider's cancellation fee in full, so the rider does not fund a dispute the platform has not resolved against a driver with five no-show terminations in thirty days. That direction, not a NO_ACTION on the charge, is what this record produces.

This is a rider-filed dispute (dispute.filed_by is RIDER) and EV-FARE-00856 shows the cancellation fee as CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00. Under POL-GEN-03, NO_ACTION is party-relative and leaves fare_breakdown.payment_status exactly where it is, so on this dispute NO_ACTION would leave the rider still carrying the disputed SGD 4.50; ESCALATE, by contrast, holds the amount rather than collecting it. The only disposition in the ruling vocabulary that does not leave the rider carrying the disputed charge on this record is the escalation, and the rider asks for it.

ledger.claim: The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event for TRP-00856 at 2026-09-16 18:10:00, sourced from PLATFORM_TELEMETRY, so limb (a) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied on the face of the record.

The driver was inside the pickup geofence at or before that event. The exported trace consists of 25 consecutive fixes between 18:10:00 and 18:14:00, every one of them 0.0 m from the pickup pin and stationary, which is comfortably inside the 150 m arrival radius the policy sets for a TRANSPORT_HUB pickup such as this one. POL-NS-01(b) and the POL-NS-02 proximity test are therefore met, with far more than the three consecutive in-radius qualifying fixes POL-NS-02 requires.

The dwell requirement in POL-NS-01(c) is met with a margin. The driver held position continuously from 18:10:00 to 18:14:00 - 240 seconds across 25 stationary fixes at the 10-second cadence - against a free waiting period in force of 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180), a 60-second surplus. The dwell is measured, as the clause requires, from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and not from the arrival tap (dwell_start_offset_sec = 0.0), and it still clears the minimum. platform_policy.no_show_threshold_sec is null, so no longer threshold applies.

Limb (d) of POL-NS-01 holds. The trip record shows no boarding event and a termination by the driver at 18:14:00, after the required dwell had elapsed, recorded under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three reason codes the limb recognises. Nothing in the record shows a DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE admission, which is the only outcome the limb excludes.

The arrival marker is not false and POL-NS-05 is not engaged. At the 18:10:00 marker the driver was 0.0 m from the pickup pin - not more than 300 m away - and his recorded speed was 0 km/h, below the 15 km/h motion threshold. The waiting clock therefore runs from 18:10:00 as recorded, and there is no basis on this record to recompute it.

POL-NS-06's refund route is not triggered: the effective in-geofence dwell of 240 seconds exceeds the 180-second minimum, so there is no shortfall (the computed shortfall is -60 seconds, that is, a surplus of 60). Limb (i) cannot be stretched to reach a shortfall either: EV-ADVIS-00856-01 is MISSING - I disclose that it carries weight 0.0 and the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, with no payload - and a MISSING advisory makes limb (i) unavailable; in any event the trace shows a single continuous in-geofence interval (run_count 1), not the two separate intervals limb (i) exists to add together.

No rider-exonerating clause applies. POL-NS-04 fails at limb (a) and affirmatively at limb (c). The rider's only message, sent at 18:10:30, was 'I cannot get there in time', which names no position, entrance, block, tower or bay and does not say the vehicle could not be seen, so it is not locating or coordinating content within limb (a); and the rider's device was recorded about 667 m from the pickup pin throughout, outside the 200 m rider-presence radius for a TRANSPORT_HUB, with zero qualifying fixes - limb (c) is affirmatively failed on admissible fixes, not undecidable, so POL-NS-11 does not apply.

The chat log corroborates the no-show rather than any driver-side coordination failure. The driver posted 'I am at the pickup point. Are you coming?' at 18:10:10, the rider read it at 18:10:12, and the rider's own reply at 18:10:30 was an admission that they could not get there. The driver gave the rider the waiting window and the rider's answer was that they were not coming.

The amount charged is the correct one and there is no fare-integrity defect. EV-FARE-00856 places the cancellation-fee line at SGD 4.50, equal to the net fee in force on this trip (platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd = 4.50), which is the net figure the POL-NS-08(d) reconciliation requires; no booking fee, platform fee or waiting-time fee was added on top, and SGD 0.00 has been refunded.

On a verified no-show POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 per cent of the SGD 4.50 fee in force - SGD 3.60, the figure the fare breakdown's own money block computes - the residual 20 per cent being retained as the platform service fee. I do not overstate this. The clause's anti-farming check is engaged on the recorded profile: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 5, at or above the threshold of 4, and 5 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 50 is 0.10, above the 0.08 rate limb, so both limbs of that check are met on the figures and whether the SGD 3.60 is paid or withheld for escalation under POL-NS-09(d) is for the Judge to determine. I note only that the check reads the trailing-30-day counter no_show_terminations_30d, not the lifetime prior_no_show_flags counter, which POL-GEN-01 makes context only.

ledger.claim: There is no repeat-pairing or rider-side abuse escalation on this record: rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so POL-NS-09(c)'s test of two or more no-show disputes between the same rider and driver in the trailing 90 days is not met, and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, so POL-NS-09(d)'s rider-side limb is not met either. No admissible artifact contradicts another on arrival, dwell or rider presence, so POL-NS-09(b) is likewise not engaged; the driver's track and the rider's track both speak with one voice about where each party was.
